# `json_fmt`

A JSON array of objects, one per row, for the public export endpoint.

Every value is written as a JSON string, so consumers never have to guess types.

Usage: `from textkit.formats.json_fmt import render`

Sample output:

```
[
  {"sku": "W-1", "name": "Widget", "qty": "3"},
  {"sku": "G-2", "name": "Gadget, large", "qty": ""}
]
```
